SASBDB entry SASDDG7  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDDG7/)

Publication: Small but large enough: structural properties of armless mitochondrial tRNAs from the nematode Romanomermis culicivorax.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gky593

The publisher's PDF is not kept in this folder; fetch it from the DOI above. The fitting
script test/fitting_tests/SASDDG7/ cites what it takes from the SASBDB record.

Files: fit1 (PyMOL model of tRNA-Ile, CRYSOL chi2 1.659), unmodified.

Audit (2026-11-13, round 5): buffer (50 mM HEPES-NaOH pH 7.4, 10 mM MgCl2, low salt), wavelength 1.033 A and the model construction checked against the paper (Materials and Methods, SAXS, p. 9171-9172). Temperature 15 C is SASBDB-only.
